name: English

lines.greeting: Hello {name}. This is Care Taker, calling from your hospital.
lines.askTaken: Have you eaten? Have you taken your {slot} tablets?
lines.progress: You are on day {n} of {total}. Your doctor asked you to complete the course.
lines.readback: You took your {slot} tablets at {time}. Is that right? Say yes or press 1.
lines.confirmed: Thank you. I have written it down.
lines.askAgain: Sorry. Please tell me again. Have you taken your {slot} tablets?
lines.notTakenOffer: Will you take it now? I can call back in 30 minutes.
lines.takeNow: Please take it now. I will call back in {minutes} minutes to check.
lines.postponeOk: Okay. I will call you again in {minutes} minutes.
lines.postponeLimit: We have moved this dose three times. I am telling your care team.
lines.nurseComing: A nurse will call you in a few minutes.
lines.askWhyStopped: Can you tell me why you stopped?
lines.tellingTeam: Thank you. I am telling your care team.
lines.unclear: Sorry, I did not hear that clearly. Have you taken your {slot} tablets?
lines.keypad: Please use the keypad. Press 1 if you have taken it. Press 2 to call later. Press 3 to talk to a nurse.
lines.noKey: I did not get an answer. I am telling your care team.
lines.goodbye: Take care. I will call again at {time}.
lines.goodbyeDone: Take care. This was the last dose of your course.
lines.optOut: All right. I will stop the calls. Your care team will be told.

samples: I have not eaten, call me in 20 minutes
I feel fine, I have stopped

ui.detect: Or just speak, and Care Taker finds your language
ui.addDevice: Add a watch, ring or monitor

feedback.stepsToday: {steps} steps today. Your doctor's goal is {goal} a day.
feedback.stepsTodayMet: {steps} steps today. Your doctor's goal is {goal} a day: reached.
feedback.stepsAverage: Last {days} days: {avg} steps a day on average, goal reached on {met} of {days} days.
feedback.activeCaloriesTotal: {active} active calories burned today, {total} in total.
feedback.heartRateOut: Heart rate {bpm} at {time}, outside your doctor's range. A nurse will look at it.
feedback.bpIn: Last blood pressure {sys}/{dia} at {time}, inside your doctor's range.
feedback.bpOut: Last blood pressure {sys}/{dia} at {time}, outside your doctor's range. A nurse will look at it.
feedback.sugarIn: Last sugar {mgdl} mg/dL at {time}, inside your doctor's range.
feedback.sugarInContext: Last sugar {mgdl} mg/dL ({context}) at {time}, inside your doctor's range.
feedback.sugarOut: Last sugar {mgdl} mg/dL at {time}, outside your doctor's range. A nurse will look at it.
feedback.sugarOutContext: Last sugar {mgdl} mg/dL ({context}) at {time}, outside your doctor's range. A nurse will look at it.
feedback.oxygenOut: Oxygen {pct}% at {time}, outside your doctor's range. A nurse will look at it.
feedback.weekOneIn: {count} blood pressure and sugar reading this week, inside your doctor's range. It is shared with your care team.
feedback.weekOneOut: {count} blood pressure and sugar reading this week, {out} outside your doctor's range. It is shared with your care team.
feedback.weekAllIn: {count} blood pressure and sugar readings this week, all inside your doctor's range. All are shared with your care team.
feedback.weekSomeOut: {count} blood pressure and sugar readings this week, {out} outside your doctor's range. All are shared with your care team.
feedback.devicePaired: {device} is paired. Readings appear when it takes one.
feedback.noDevice: No device connected yet. Readings can also be added by voice or typed.
